answer: Counterparty diversity stops sybil farms: rewards require trades with twelve independent counterparties per epoch, and the farmer's own clique trades score zero. A verifier rejects loops where value circles back like a river, passing only outside, verified routes. Faking N identities needs 12×N real trades with strangers, each paying fees plus escrow, so attacker cost grows linearly with N while an honest agent pays one set. Honest agents swim in the ocean of the open market, so the network's nectar flows only to diverse, real trade histories.
